target.title: docs: default agent validation to remote runners
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Agent sessions could run tests and broad validation locally because the repository guidance did not make remote execution or early Testbox warmup the default. Reused-box examples could also skip source sync, while contributor code lacked a safe remote routing boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

Make Crabbox remote execution the agent default for tests and compute-heavy work, with early Blacksmith Testbox warmup and lease reuse for trusted maintainer code. Add a fail-closed direct-AWS path for untrusted PRs: trusted launcher/config, public networking without Tailscale, no instance role or hydrated credentials, immutable reviewed SHA, isolated home, and a checksum-verified pinned Node/pnpm bootstrap.

## User Impact

Maintainer agents should stop bogging down local Macs with test and validation workloads. Trusted work gets fast pre-warmed Testboxes; untrusted contributor code cannot inherit maintainer credentials, IAM roles, tailnet access, stale source, or a moving PR head.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/docs-list.js`
- YAML frontmatter parsed for all three changed skills
- `bash -n scripts/crabbox-untrusted-bootstrap.sh`
- `shellcheck scripts/crabbox-untrusted-bootstrap.sh`
- Bootstrap pnpm pin verified against `package.json`
- Crabbox CLI flags verified for warmup, `--fresh-pr`, `--no-hydrate`, provider routing, shell execution, and timing JSON
- Fresh autoreview completed with no accepted/actionable findings after security and network hardening
- Direct AWS Crabbox lease `cbx_4e515c3ad67f`: trusted bootstrap run `run_1b26c9c691f0` passed IMDS no-role proof, Node archive checksum verification, Node `v24.15.0`, and pnpm `11.2.2`
- `crabbox inspect` verified `network=public` with no Tailscale state before remote execution
